liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **May 2010 (Friday)**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Kentucky Derby Call > Intro &gt**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **Run Thru &gt**: back after 28 archived shows (662 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **Encore Call**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **Wordless**: back after 51 archived shows (1247 days); rare: 5 archived performances [13]
- **Carnival Time**: rare: 7 archived performances [13]
- **Move On Up**: rare: 10 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **mmj2010-05-01.vwmule24bit** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 124 min [1]
- **mmj2010-05-01.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 125 min [2]
- **mmj2010-05-01**: source not stated; 22 songs; 124 min; rated 5/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener described the audio as sounding like the band was live in their home; Reviewer praised the high quality of the audio recording; Reviewer stated the taper captured the band's performance very well [5][8][10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended their first My Morning Jacket concert at this venue [4]
- The crowd in the pit was described as wild and wooly [6]
- Reviewer characterized the overall atmosphere of the performance as hot [7]
- Reviewer called the pit experience the wildest concert crowd they had ever seen [10]
- A song listed on the printed setlist between Wordless and Carnival Time was not played [12]
- Preservation Hall Jazz Band opened and joined the rest of the show [1]
- Reviewer found this recording superior in quality to a Chastain Park recording [11]
- Blog post lists a prior 2010 show at Koka Booth in Cary, NC [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj2010-05-01.vwmule24bit**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Milab VM-44 Link > Darktrain silver interconnects > Edirol R-44 (24/48) [1]
- **mmj2010-05-01.flac1644**: taped by Mark Lynn; transferred by Mark Lynn; source: At Soundboard:DPA(B&K) 4011s->V2->Luminous Synchestra Signature XLRs->SD 722 @ 24/48 [2]. Also: Soundboard recording used DPA 4011 mics, V2 preamp, and SD 722 recorder [2]
- **mmj2010-05-01**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Source: Milab VM-44 Link > Darktrain silver interconnects > Edirol R-44 (24/48) [3]
